item.title: On debut, Jio 2nd most valuable company, behind only parent Reliance Industries
item.description: Jio Platforms successfully listed its shares at a premium price of Rs 1,358 on debut day. The stock surged to Rs 1,419, resulting in a market capitalisation of Rs 13.1 lakh crore. The listing also elevated the RIL group to the top of India's most valued business houses. Jio’s IPO was oversubscribed more than 22 times, indicating strong investor interest.

item.title: Microsoft employees in India can now opt for a buyout: Who qualifies and what it pays
item.description: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 employees, over a quarter of its workforce, in India, the US, the UK and Canada. HR head Amy Coleman announced the Voluntary Exit Offer in a memo to staff. The package matches standard severance, which can run up to 39 weeks of pay. Xbox, Copilot and Windows teams are eligible, sales is excluded, and the deadline is December.

item.title: Florida court reverses HOA auction cancellation made without hearing buyer
item.description: A Florida homeowner paid his outstanding homeowners' association fees five days after his property was sold at a foreclosure auction in October 2024. The sale was subsequently cancelled, but the winning bidder challenged the decision, saying it had not been heard. Nearly two years later, a Florida appeals court overturned the cancellation and ordered a fresh hearing.

item.title: Diver finds centuries-old three-legged iron cauldron in England's River Wear
item.description: An ancient iron cauldron, potentially from the medieval or Iron Age, was found submerged under water. Underwater archaeologist Gary Bankhead led a team of divers in this ambitious recovery mission. Experts are currently investigating the cauldron's design and historical relevance. This intriguing find prompts speculation about its origin and journey into the river, with plans underway for a public exhibition at a nearby museum.

item.title: Dropbox layoffs: Co-CEO announces 9% job cuts in company memo
item.description: Dropbox has announced a significant reduction in its workforce, planning to eliminate approximately 9% of its positions as part of a strategic realignment of resources. This move is expected to result in severance expenses ranging from $27 million to $33 million, impacting the company's financials primarily in Q4 of 2026.

item.title: Georgia court backs daughter as guardian of mother, 95, amid sibling dispute
item.description: A dispute between three siblings over their 95-year-old mother's care reached the Georgia Court of Appeals after one son restricted his sister's visits and questions emerged over the handling of their mother's money. The woman, who has advanced dementia, had previously authorised her son to manage her affairs. However, the court upheld her daughter's appointment as guardian.

item.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current set attendance record with 18,000 fans
item.description: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes' KC Current made history by welcoming a record crowd for their final home match of the 2026 season. Around 18,000 fans were expected, including 6,000 at Current Landing, where a $10 Ground Pass offered outdoor viewing, food and entertainment. The club also celebrated two new dining options and plans to host more events, expanding its reach beyond CPKC Stadium and strengthening its connection with Kansas City.

item.title: Andre Agassi’s $6.5M Las Vegas land sells for $18.15M in 2026
item.description: Andre Agassi sold his 1.8-acre homesite in Las Vegas’ exclusive Summit Club for $18.15 million, nearly tripling the $6.5 million he paid in 2018. The sale generated an $11.65 million gain before expenses. His brother, Phillip Agassi, said the tennis legend reconsidered building a large mansion as his children grow older. The buyer’s identity remains unknown, while the property’s location and luxury surroundings add to its appeal.

item.title: World Wrestling C'ships: India script history as Neelam, Kajal settle for silver
item.description: India’s Kajal Dhochak and Neelam Sirohi created history by winning silver medals at the World Wrestling Championships in Astana, becoming the first Indian women to reach finals at the same edition. Kajal narrowly lost 6-8 to Ukraine’s Anastasiya Alpyeyeva, while Neelam fell to Japan’s Yui Susaki, securing India’s landmark double-silver finish.

item.title: Cyclone Arnab leaves trail of destruction in Andhra, 8 killed
item.description: In the wake of severe cyclonic storm Arnab, eight fatalities have been reported across Andhra Pradesh. The cyclone caused extensive damage, uprooting trees and downing power lines, leaving many communities in despair with flooding and blackouts. Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu has appealed for central government support to manage the disaster's impact, though early evaluations show that certain coconut crops remained relatively unscathed.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Man clings to moving Thar SUV as traffic cops try to seize vehicle in Gurgaon
item.description: On a Tuesday evening, traffic police pulled over a black Mahindra Thar for inspection after noticing violations, including the absence of a number plate and heavily tinted windows. The driver was unable to provide any documents, leading to a confrontation as one passenger desperately clung to the driver-side window while the car tried to flee. The police confiscated the Thar and are pursuing further legal measures regarding this incident.

item.title: 'Diwali gift from PM Modi': Cabinet approves 3% DA increase for central govt employees
item.description: In a significant move ahead of the Diwali celebrations, the Union Cabinet has approved a 3 percent increase in Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief for central government employees and pensioners, impacting more than 1.17 crore beneficiaries. Effective from July 1, 2026, this adjustment elevates the DA and DR from 60 to 63 percent of basic pay and pension.

item.title: Spain train crash: Drone footage captures twisted carriages as toll tops 60
item.description: The crash occurred along the Madrid-Seville high-speed railway line in Toledo province, where two trains carrying hundreds of passengers were travelling in the same direction towards Seville in southwestern Spain, according to Esther Padilla, spokesperson for the Castilla-La Mancha regional government. Spain's rail infrastructure operator ADIF said the accident took place on Wednesday morning.

item.title: SC says legality of EC's 'logical discrepancy' checks in SIR remains undecided
item.description: A bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana said its earlier decision allowing the Election Commission to use the category in West Bengal was only an interim measure. It also clarified that the court’s ruling on the SIR exercise in Bihar had not settled every legal question surrounding the revision process.

item.title: Disabled flyer stranded 24 hrs at airport without wheelchair, airlines to pay Rs 60k
item.description: A 65-year-old disabled passenger, Kirpal Singh, faced issues during his air travel from Amritsar to London. Singh did not receive the requested wheelchair assistance at Istanbul airport, leaving him stranded for nearly 24 hours. His checked-in baggage was delayed, causing him to miss a subsequent flight to Toronto after arriving in London. Following his complaints, the consumer commission ordered both airlines to pay compensation for the harassment experienced.

item.title: Happy Karwa Chauth 2026: Images, wishes, quotes and greeting cards
item.description: On October 29, 2026, the much-anticipated Karwa Chauth festival will be celebrated, highlighting the deep bond of love as people fast for their partners. This annual event is marked by exchanging warm wishes and quotes, especially toward mothers-in-law and respected seniors, acknowledging their vital role in the festivities. The rituals serve to strengthen community ties and express unwavering devotion.

item.description: Rahul Gandhi responded to Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman regarding the Tata Group's ongoing dispute. He questioned the motives behind hosting Tata representatives at Amit Shah's residence.
